verdict.rationale: Evidence shows group-based bulk operations and a Graph API that traverses direct and indirect group bindings, implying group-based access assignment, but nothing explicitly documents dynamic/rule-based group membership (e.g., attribute-based auto-assignment) or a UI workflow for group-to-app binding. missing for 10: explicit dynamic group membership rules documentation, explicit group-to-app assignment workflow description, independent/hands-on confirmation of dynamic grouping.
